Welfare walks before lunch brought a short delay Incident Report: Companion Animal Travel Desk, Aurelia Skyways

Welfare walks before lunch brought a short delay when a cabin transfer was paused after staff noticed that one pet carrier had shifted in the staging area. The traveler remained calm, and the animal inside showed no sign of distress. The delay started during routine movement from the check-in zone to the departure holding area, where the escort team stopped the handoff and completed a welfare check. Clear guidance had already been given to the traveler before departure, and trained staff were on hand throughout.

The duty coordinator opened the report and confirmed the carrier latch, door seal, and identity label. The animal was then observed in a quiet area while a second staff member reviewed the travel documents and storage placement. <<FACT F120>> The traveler was informed that the case would be documented and that the pet would not continue until the carrier was secure and the routing note was updated. Bailey, a pet on a separate booking, was also kept under close watch during the same flow, which helped keep the team focused on safety and order.

Handling was completed by reseating the carrier, checking the bedding, and moving the animal by a direct route with one escort. No injury was noted, no further disruption followed, and the departure file was corrected before release. The follow-up is to review staging discipline, reinforce carrier checks with the ground team, and remind all desk staff to flag any shifted load immediately. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will monitor the next outbound handoffs closely and keep the operation under review.
